title: Wasalt Business Solutions — Saudi Real Estate B2B Platform
raw_content:
Wasalt Business Solutions

Wasalt Business is the dedicated enterprise platform connecting Saudi real estate developers, agencies, brokers, and certified property managers.

Key Business Features:

  • REGA (Real Estate General Authority) license verification and authorized advertisement compliance (Val license integration).
  • Direct CRM property management and automated syndication across web and mobile applications.
  • Verified escrow and E-Wallet payment guarantees for auctions and digital transactions.
  • Advanced lead tracking, property analytics, and developer dashboard reporting.
